sql:
SELECT slot, payload FROM (
              WITH counts AS MATERIALIZED (
                SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN (((COALESCE(json_type(data, '$.done') = ?, 0)))) THEN 1 END) AS c0,COUNT(CASE WHEN (1) THEN 1 END) AS c1 FROM nss_entity
                WHERE coll = ? AND data != '' AND json_valid(data)
              ), promoted AS MATERIALIZED (
                SELECT id FROM nss_entity WHERE coll = ? AND data = ''
              ) SELECT 0 AS slot,
                CASE WHEN length(CAST(payload AS BLOB)) <= 1048576 THEN payload END AS payload
                FROM (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'value',value)) AS payload
                  FROM (SELECT id,NULL AS value FROM promoted UNION ALL SELECT NULL,c0 FROM counts)) UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS slot,
                CASE WHEN length(CAST(payload AS BLOB)) <= 1048576 THEN payload END AS payload
                FROM (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'value',value)) AS payload
                  FROM (SELECT id,NULL AS value FROM promoted UNION ALL SELECT NULL,c1 FROM counts))
            )
